metadata.description: Agent skills that check work before it leaves your hands: a website before it deploys, a draft before it is sent, a post before it is published.

plugins.name: website-review-build
plugins.description: Audit and build marketing and content websites so they stay correct after launch: every rule an automated check, every check in a gate that can stop a bad deploy, every check seen to fail.

plugins.name: second-draft
plugins.description: Question a draft Claude helped write before it goes out: trace every number, date and claim to an exact line, page or cell in your files, read it as its reader would, and apply your organisation's rules.

plugins.name: company-post-scoring
plugins.description: Score or draft posts for a company page against a pass-or-fail gate, eight criteria out of 16 and a publish threshold.
